children: Q3 2026 revenue was $7.87M versus $7.18M in 2025, and net loss was $1.59M versus $2.13M. Nine-month revenue was $19.96M versus $21.76M, and net loss was $5.86M versus $4.25M.
Revenue increased about 10% year over year, signaling a stronger quarter after weaker first-half revenue.
The quarterly loss narrowed year over year, though the company remained unprofitable.
Year-to-date revenue declined about 8%, indicating the Q3 improvement has not reversed the cumulative shortfall.
The year-to-date loss widened, offsetting the improvement in Q3.
The non-GAAP operating loss narrowed year over year; nine-month adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $4.37M from $3.22M.
The reported period-end balance is a liquidity reference; management separately said cash had risen to $5.7M today.

This is a mixed quarterly update: Q3 revenue and losses improved year over year, while nine-month revenue fell and losses widened. Investors will look for sustained revenue growth, improved year-to-date profitability, and confirmation of management's stated current cash position and backlog conversion.
